units.source_text: 秀男又沉下脸来，“我还年轻，加上又是个手艺人，不是那么识货。

en.t: Hideo’s face clouded over again. “I am still young, and besides, I am only a craftsman, so I do not have such a discerning eye.

units.source_text: 您不是说这是隐居在嵯峨尼姑庵里画出来的吗？”

en.t: Did you not say this was painted while living in seclusion at a nunnery in Saga?”
